units.zh: 志二十二
units.en: Treatise 22

units.zh: 時憲三
units.en: Shixian Calendar 3
units.literal: Shixian 3

units.zh: 康熙甲子元法上上卷述立法之原，中卷志七政恆星之順軌，下卷志諸曜相距之數。
units.en: The Kangxi jiazi calendrical system has three parts: the first explains how the methods were established; the second charts the regular motions of the sun, moon, five planets, and fixed stars; the third records the distances between the heavenly bodies.
units.literal: The Kangxi jiazi epoch system: the upper fascicle sets forth the origins of legislation; the middle fascicle records the ordered courses of the seven luminaries and fixed stars; the lower fascicle records the distances between the various planets.

units.zh: 日躔立法之原：
units.en: Foundations of the solar-motion methods:
units.literal: Origins of legislation for solar motion:

units.zh: 一，求南北真線以正面位。
units.en: First, establish the true meridian to fix the cardinal directions.
units.literal: First, find the true north-south line to fix the cardinal orientation.

units.zh: 用方案極平，作圜數層，植表於圜心取日影。
units.en: On a level platform lay out concentric circles and set a gnomon at the center to mark the sun's shadow.
units.literal: Use a level surface, lay out several concentric circles, and plant a gnomon at the center to take the sun's shadow.

units.zh: 識表末影切圜上者，視左右兩點同在一圜聯為直線，即正東西；
units.en: Mark where the shadow tip meets each circle; when the left and right marks fall on one circle, the line joining them is true east-west;
units.literal: Mark where the gnomon's shadow-tip touches a circle; when the left and right marks lie on the same circle, join them as a straight line—that is due east-west;

units.zh: 取東西線正中向圜心作垂線，即正南北。
units.en: a perpendicular from its midpoint to the center gives true north-south.
units.literal: From the midpoint of the east-west line draw a perpendicular toward the center—that is due north-south.

units.zh: 於京師以羅針較之，偏東四度餘。
units.en: At Beijing it was compared with the compass and found to lie more than four degrees east of magnetic north.
units.literal: At the capital, compared with the compass, it deviates eastward by a little over four degrees.

units.zh: 乾隆十七年改為二度三十分。
units.en: In Qianlong 17 this was revised to 2°30′.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year of Qianlong it was revised to two degrees thirty minutes.

units.zh: 一，測北極高度以定天體。
units.en: Second, measure the altitude of the north celestial pole to establish the local celestial coordinates.
units.literal: Second, measure the north polar altitude to fix the celestial sphere.

units.zh: 於冬至前後，用儀器測勾陳大星出地之度，酉時此星在北極之上，候其漸轉而高，至不復高而止。
units.en: Around the winter solstice, observers measured Kochab's altitude above the horizon with instruments; in the evening hour, when the star was above the pole, they noted its rising altitude until it ceased to climb.
units.literal: Around the winter solstice, use instruments to measure the altitude of Kochab above the horizon; in the you hour this star is above the pole—wait until it gradually turns and rises, stopping when it rises no higher.

units.zh: 卯時此星在北極之下，候其漸轉而低，至不復低而止。
units.en: In the early-morning hour, when the star was below the pole, they recorded its falling altitude until it ceased to descend.
units.literal: In the mao hour this star is below the pole—wait until it gradually turns and descends, stopping when it descends no lower.

units.zh: 以最高最低之度折中取之，為北極高度。
units.en: The mean of the highest and lowest readings gives the north polar altitude.
units.literal: Take the mean between the highest and lowest degrees as the north polar altitude.

units.zh: 恆星無地半徑差，勾陳距地又高，蒙氣差亦微，其數確准。
units.en: Fixed stars suffer no parallax, Kochab stands high above the horizon, and refraction is negligible, so the result is highly reliable.
units.literal: Fixed stars have no terrestrial semidiameter parallax; Kochab is also high above the horizon, and atmospheric refraction is slight—the number is reliably accurate.

units.zh: 以此測得申昜春園北極高三十九度五十九分三十秒。
units.en: By this method the north polar altitude at Changchun Garden was found to be 39°59′30″.
units.literal: By this method Changchun Garden's north polar altitude was measured as thirty-nine degrees fifty-nine minutes thirty seconds.

units.zh: 一，求地半徑差以驗地心實高、地面視高之不同。
units.en: Third, determine parallax to distinguish true geocentric altitude from apparent altitude at the observer's location.
units.literal: Third, find the terrestrial semidiameter parallax to verify the difference between geocentric true altitude and apparent altitude at the surface.

units.zh: 康熙五十四年五月甲子午正，在申昜春園測得太陽高七十三度一十六分零二十三微，同時於廣東廣州府測得太陽高九十度零六分二十一秒四十八微。
units.en: At noon on jiazi day of the fifth month, Kangxi 54, Changchun Garden recorded the sun at 73°16′0″23‴ while Guangzhou, Guangdong, simultaneously recorded 90°6′21″48‴.
units.literal: On the jiazi day of the fifth month, Kangxi 54, at noon Shenyang Spring Garden measured the sun's altitude as seventy-three degrees sixteen minutes zero seconds twenty-three micro-units; at the same time Guangzhou in Guangdong measured ninety degrees six minutes twenty-one seconds forty-eight micro-units.

units.zh: 申昜春園赤道距天頂三十九度五十九分三十秒，廣州府赤道距天頂二十三度十分，偏西三度三十三分。
units.en: At Changchun Garden the equator stood 39°59′30″ from the zenith; at Guangzhou, 23°10′, with Guangzhou 3°33′ west of Changchun Garden.
units.literal: Shenyang Spring Garden's equator is thirty-nine degrees fifty-nine minutes thirty seconds from the zenith; Guangzhou's equator is twenty-three degrees ten minutes from the zenith, three degrees thirty-three minutes west.

units.zh: 時夏至後八日，日躔最高，用平三角形推得地半徑與太陽距地心比例，如一與一千一百六十二。
units.en: Eight days after the summer solstice, with the sun at apogee, plane-triangle calculation gave the ratio of Earth's radius to the sun's geocentric distance as 1:1162.
units.literal: It was eight days after the summer solstice, the sun at apogee; using plane triangles the ratio of terrestrial radius to the sun's distance from the geocenter was derived as one to one thousand one hundred sixty-two.

units.zh: 又康熙五十五年三月丙申午正，在申昜春園測得太陽高五十三度零三分三十八秒一十微，同時於廣東廣州府測得太陽高六十九度五十四分零八秒三十六微。
units.en: Again, at noon on bingshen day of the third month, Kangxi 55, Changchun Garden recorded 53°3′38″10‴ and Guangzhou 69°54′8″36‴.
units.literal: Again, on bingshen day of the third month, Kangxi 55, at noon Shenyang Spring Garden measured the sun at fifty-three degrees three minutes thirty-eight seconds ten micro-units; at the same time Guangzhou measured sixty-nine degrees fifty-four minutes eight seconds thirty-six micro-units.

units.zh: 時春分後八日，日躔中距，推得地半徑與太陽距地心比例，如一與一千一百四十二。
units.en: Eight days after the spring equinox, with the sun at mean distance, the same method gave a ratio of 1:1142.
units.literal: It was eight days after the spring equinox, the sun at mean distance; the ratio of terrestrial radius to the sun's distance from the geocenter was derived as one to one thousand one hundred forty-two.

units.zh: 乃以太陽最高與本天半徑比例數一０一七九二０八與地半徑比例數一一六二之比，為太陽最卑與本天半徑比例數九八二０七九二與地半徑比例之比，得一千一百二十一。
units.en: Proportioning apogee distance (deferent radius 10179208, Earth ratio 1162) to perigee distance (9820792) yields a mean Earth-ratio of 1121.
units.literal: Then taking the ratio of the sun at apogee to the deferent radius, 10179208, to the terrestrial-radius ratio 1162, as equal to the ratio of the sun at perigee to the deferent radius, 9820792, to the terrestrial-radius ratio, one obtains 1121.

units.zh: 既得三限距地心之遠，用平三角形逐度皆推得地半徑差。
units.en: With the three limiting solar distances established, parallax for every degree was computed by plane triangles.
units.literal: Once the three limiting distances from the geocenter were obtained, plane triangles were used to derive the terrestrial semidiameter parallax for every degree.

units.zh: 一，求黃赤距緯以正黃道。
units.en: Fourth, determine ecliptic declination to establish the ecliptic.
units.literal: Fourth, find ecliptic latitude relative to the equator to fix the ecliptic.

units.zh: 康熙五十三年，於申昜春園累測夏至午正太陽高度，得視高七十三度二十九分十餘秒。
units.en: In Kangxi 53 repeated summer-solstice noon observations at Changchun Garden gave an apparent solar altitude of about 73°29′10″.
units.literal: In Kangxi 53, repeated measurements at Shenyang Spring Garden of the sun's altitude at summer-solstice noon yielded apparent altitude seventy-three degrees twenty-nine minutes and a little over ten seconds.

units.zh: 加地半徑差五十秒，得實高七十三度三十分。
units.en: Adding 50″ of parallax yields a true altitude of 73°30′.
units.literal: Adding terrestrial semidiameter parallax of fifty seconds gives true altitude seventy-three degrees thirty minutes.

units.zh: 減去本地赤道高五十度零三十秒，餘二十三度二十九分三十秒，為黃赤大距。
units.en: Subtracting the local equatorial altitude of 50°0′30″ leaves 23°29′30″ as the obliquity of the ecliptic.
units.literal: Subtracting local equatorial altitude fifty degrees thirty seconds leaves twenty-three degrees twenty-nine minutes thirty seconds as the great ecliptic-equatorial distance.

units.zh: 用弧三角形逐度皆推得距緯。
units.en: Spherical triangles then gave the declination for every degree.
units.literal: Using spherical triangles, latitude distance was derived for every degree.

units.zh: 一，求清蒙氣差以驗地中游氣映小為大、升卑為高之數。
units.en: Fifth, determine atmospheric refraction to quantify how near-horizon air magnifies apparent size and raises apparent altitude.
units.literal: Fifth, find atmospheric refraction to verify the numbers by which air in the middle of the earth makes small appear large and low appear high.

units.zh: 明萬曆間，西人第谷於其國北極出地五十五度有奇，測得地平上最大差三十四分。
units.en: During the Wanli era Tycho Brahe, at latitude 55°+, measured a maximum horizon refraction of 34′.
units.literal: During the Wanli reign, the Western scholar Tycho at his country where the north pole rises a little over fifty-five degrees above the horizon measured maximum refraction at the horizon as thirty-four minutes.

units.zh: 自地平以上，其差漸少，至四十五度，其差五秒，更高無差。
units.en: Above the horizon refraction decreases steadily; at 45° it is only 5″, and higher altitudes show none.
units.literal: Above the horizon the difference gradually diminishes; at forty-five degrees the difference is five seconds; higher up there is no difference.

units.zh: 其測算之法，如太陽視高十度三十四分四十二秒，距正午八十三度，於時日躔降婁宮三度三十六分，距赤道北一度二十六分。
units.en: His procedure, for example: with apparent solar altitude 10°34′42″, hour-angle 83°, the sun in Jiang at 3°36′ and 1°26′ north of the equator—
units.literal: His measuring method: suppose the sun's apparent altitude is ten degrees thirty-four minutes forty-two seconds, distance from noon eighty-three degrees; at the time the sun was in Jiang palace 3 degrees 36 minutes, north of the equator by one degree twenty-six minutes.

units.zh: 北極距天頂五十度零三十秒，用距正午、距赤道北、北極距天頂三度，作弧三角形，求得太陽實高十度二十七分五十三秒。
units.en: with the pole 50°0′30″ from the zenith, a spherical triangle from hour-angle, declination, and polar distance yields true altitude 10°27′53″.
units.literal: the pole fifty degrees thirty seconds from the zenith—using hour-angle from noon, distance north of equator, and pole distance from zenith, form a spherical triangle and obtain the sun's true altitude ten degrees twenty-seven minutes fifty-three seconds.

units.zh: 與視高相減，又加地半徑差二分五十七秒，得九分四十六秒，為地平上十度三十五分之蒙氣差。
units.en: Subtracting this from the apparent altitude and adding 2′57″ of parallax gives 9′46″ as the refraction at 10°35′ altitude.
units.literal: Subtract from apparent altitude, then add terrestrial semidiameter parallax two minutes fifty-seven seconds, obtaining nine minutes forty-six seconds as the refraction for ten degrees thirty-five minutes above the horizon.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，測歲實以定平行。
units.en: Sixth, measure the tropical year to establish mean solar motion.
units.literal: Sixth, measure the tropical year to fix mean motion.

units.zh: 康熙五十四年二月癸未午正，於申昜春園測得太陽高五十度零三十二秒三十五微，加地半徑差一分五十六秒零五微，得實高五十度零二分二十八秒四十微。
units.en: At noon on guiwei day of the second month, Kangxi 54, Changchun Garden recorded 50°0′32″35‴; adding 1′56″05‴ of parallax yields 50°2′28″40‴ true altitude.
units.literal: On guiwei day of the second month, Kangxi 54, at noon Shenyang Spring Garden measured the sun at fifty degrees thirty-two seconds thirty-five micro-units; adding terrestrial semidiameter parallax one minute fifty-six seconds five micro-units gives true altitude fifty degrees two minutes twenty-eight seconds forty micro-units.

units.zh: 此所加地半徑差，仍新法算書舊數加之，其實地半徑與太陽距地心比例，高、卑、中距三限，次年始定，覆推無異，故不改也。
units.en: The parallax added here still used provisional figures from the New Methods; the three limiting Earth–Sun ratios were not finalized until the next year, and retrospective calculation confirmed them, so no revision was made.
units.literal: The terrestrial semidiameter parallax here added still uses the old numbers from the New Methods compendium; in fact the ratio of terrestrial radius to the sun's distance at the three limits of high, low, and mean distance was not fixed until the following year, and recalculation agreed—hence no revision.

units.zh: 至求地半徑差，取春分及夏至後八日，亦仍舊算。
units.en: Parallax was likewise computed from equinox and eighth-day-after-solstice observations by the earlier method.
units.literal: As for finding terrestrial semidiameter parallax, the spring equinox and eight days after summer solstice were still taken by the old calculation.

units.zh: 其實最高之限，累日測得，不在預定。
units.en: In fact apogee was found by daily observation and did not coincide with the predicted date.
units.literal: In fact the apogee limit was obtained by repeated daily measurement and did not fall on the predetermined day.

units.zh: 夏至中距之限既未定，歲實亦轉由最卑而得其准。
units.en: With the mean-distance limit at summer solstice still unsettled, the tropical year was instead anchored at perigee.
units.literal: Since the summer-solstice mean-distance limit was not yet fixed, the tropical year in turn obtained its standard from perigee.

units.zh: 最高最卑之比例，則在交食也。
units.en: The apogee–perigee ratio was established from eclipse observations.
units.literal: The ratio of apogee to perigee, however, comes from eclipses.

units.zh: 其廣州府偏西度，蓋先測月食時刻得之。
units.en: Guangzhou's longitude west of Changchun Garden had been determined earlier from lunar-eclipse timings.
units.literal: Guangzhou's westward offset was obtained earlier by measuring lunar-eclipse times.

units.zh: 與赤道高五十度零三十秒相減，餘一分五十八秒四十微，為太陽在赤道北之緯度。
units.en: Subtracting from the equatorial altitude of 50°0′30″ leaves 1′58″40‴ as the sun's declination north of the equator.
units.literal: Subtract from equatorial altitude fifty degrees thirty seconds; the remainder one minute fifty-eight seconds forty micro-units is the sun's latitude north of the equator.

units.zh: 知春分時在午正前，以此緯度及黃赤大距作弧三角形，推得黃道度四分五十七秒四十三微，為太陽過春分經度。
units.en: Knowing the equinox preceded noon, a spherical triangle from this declination and the obliquity gives ecliptic longitude 4′57″43‴ at the vernal equinox.
units.literal: Knowing the spring equinox fell before noon, use this latitude and the great ecliptic-equatorial distance in a spherical triangle to derive ecliptic longitude four minutes fifty-seven seconds forty-three micro-units as the sun's longitude at the vernal equinox.

units.zh: 次日午正，復測得緯度，推得太陽過春分一度零四分零六秒零三微，兩過春分度相減餘為一日之行五十九分零八秒二十微，比例得本日春分在巳初三刻十四分十秒四十八微。
units.en: Next day's noon measurement gave longitude 1°4′6″03‴ past the equinox; the difference implies daily motion of 59′8″20‴, placing that day's equinox at si 3 ke 14 fen 10 miao 48 wei.
units.literal: At noon the next day latitude was measured again, deriving the sun's passage of the vernal equinox at one degree four minutes six seconds three micro-units; subtracting the two equinox-passage degrees leaves one day's motion fifty-nine minutes eight seconds twenty micro-units; by proportion the vernal equinox that day fell at si hour third quarter fourteen minutes ten seconds forty-eight micro-units.

units.zh: 又康熙五十五年二月戊子午正，於申昜春園測得太陽高四十九度五十四分四十九秒五十一微，依法求之，得本日春分在申初三刻二分五十五秒四十八微。
units.en: Again, at noon on wuzi day of the second month, Kangxi 55, Changchun Garden recorded 49°54′49″51‴; by the same method that day's equinox fell at shen 3 ke 2 fen 55 miao 48 wei.
units.literal: Again, at noon on wuzi day of the second month, Kangxi 55, Shenyang Spring Garden measured the sun at forty-nine degrees fifty-four minutes forty-nine seconds fifty-one micro-units; by the method the vernal equinox that day fell at shen hour third quarter two minutes fifty-five seconds forty-eight micro-units.

units.zh: 總計兩春分相距三百六十五日五時三刻三分四十五秒，為歲實；
units.en: The interval between the two equinoxes totals 365 days 5 hours 3 quarters 3 minutes 45 seconds as the tropical year;
units.literal: The total interval between the two equinoxes is three hundred sixty-five days five hours three quarters three minutes forty-five seconds, as the tropical year;

units.zh: 為法，除天周，得每日平行。
units.en: dividing the celestial circuit by this value gives the sun's daily mean motion.
units.literal: use this as divisor to divide the celestial circuit and obtain daily mean motion.

units.zh: 一，求兩心差及最高所在以考盈縮。
units.en: Seventh, determine eccentricity and apogee to account for the equation of center.
units.literal: Seventh, find the two-center difference and the position of apogee to examine variation.

units.zh: 康熙五十六年二至後，申昜春園逐日測午正太陽高度，求其經度，各用本日次日比測之實行。
units.en: After the solstices of Kangxi 56, Changchun Garden took daily noon solar altitudes and derived longitudes from day-to-day true motion.
units.literal: After the two solstices of Kangxi 56, Changchun Garden measured the sun's altitude at noon daily and derived its longitude, each day using the true motion compared between that day and the next.

units.zh: 推得五月甲戌辰正一刻零四十秒四十五微交未宮七度，乙亥巳初一刻十四分五十七秒二十七微交未宮八度，十一月丁丑子正一刻一十二分五十七秒四十一微交丑宮七度，本日夜子初三刻十二分二十七秒四十七微交丑宮八度。
units.en: Calculations gave: 5th month jiaxu, chen 1 ke 0 fen 40 miao 45 wei at Wei 7°; yihai, si 1 ke 14 fen 57 miao 27 wei at Wei 8°; 11th month dingchou, zi 1 ke 12 fen 57 miao 41 wei at Chou 7°; that night zi 3 ke 12 fen 27 miao 47 wei at Chou 8°.
units.literal: It was derived: fifth month jiaxu, chen hour first quarter zero minutes forty seconds forty-five micro-units crossing Wei palace seven degrees; yihai, si hour first quarter fourteen minutes fifty-seven seconds twenty-seven micro-units crossing Wei eight degrees; eleventh month dingchou, zi hour first quarter twelve minutes fifty-seven seconds forty-one micro-units crossing Chou seven degrees; that night zi hour third quarter twelve minutes twenty-seven seconds forty-seven micro-units crossing Chou eight degrees.

units.zh: 用此兩數以立法，如圖甲為地心，即宗動天心，乙丙丁戊為黃道，與宗動天同心，乙為夏至，丙為秋分，丁為冬至，戊為春分。
units.en: From these data the model is set forth: A is Earth (the center of the primum mobile); B–E mark the ecliptic concentric with it—B summer solstice, C autumn equinox, D winter solstice, E spring equinox.
units.literal: Using these two numbers to establish the method: in the diagram A is the geocenter, that is the primum mobile center; B-C-D-E are the ecliptic, concentric with the primum mobile; B is summer solstice, C autumn equinox, D winter solstice, E spring equinox.

units.zh: 又設己點為心，作庚辛壬癸圈，為不同心天，庚為最高，當黃道子，壬為最卑，當黃道丑，寅卯為中距，過己甲兩心作庚丑線，則平分本天與黃道各為兩半周。
units.en: Point Ji is the eccentric center; circle Geng–Gui is the deferent, with Geng at apogee (ecliptic Zi) and Ren at perigee (Chou); Yin and Mao mark mean distance. The line through Ji and Jia bisects deferent and ecliptic into semicircles.
units.literal: Further set point Ji as center and draw the Geng-Xin-Ren-Gui circle as the eccentric deferent; Geng is apogee at ecliptic Zi, Ren is perigee at ecliptic Chou, Yin and Mao are mean distance; through the two centers Ji and Jia draw the Geng-Chou line, which bisects deferent and ecliptic each into two semicircles.

units.zh: 夏至乙至冬至丁，引出乙丁線，割不同心天之左半大於半周歲。
units.en: The arc from summer solstice B to winter solstice D, extended, cuts the deferent's left semicircle in more than half a year.
units.literal: From summer solstice B to winter solstice D, extend line B-D; it cuts the left semicircle of the eccentric deferent greater than half a tropical year.

units.zh: 秋分丙至春分戊，引出丙戊線，割不同心天之下半小於半周歲。
units.en: The arc from autumn equinox C to spring equinox E cuts the lower semicircle in less than half a year.
units.literal: From autumn equinox C to spring equinox E, extend line C-E; it cuts the lower semicircle of the eccentric deferent less than half a tropical year.

units.zh: 今測未宮七度至丑宮七度，歷一百八十二日一十六時一十二分一十六秒五十六微，大於半周歲一時一十七分五十四秒二十六微；
units.en: Observation from Wei 7° to Chou 7° took 182 days 16 hours 12 minutes 16 seconds 56 wei—1 hour 17 minutes 54 seconds 26 wei longer than half a year;
units.literal: Now measured from Wei palace seven degrees to Chou seven degrees, elapsed one hundred eighty-two days sixteen hours twelve minutes sixteen seconds fifty-six micro-units, greater than half a tropical year by one hour seventeen minutes fifty-four seconds twenty-six micro-units;

units.zh: 未宮八度至丑宮八度，歷一百八十二日一十四時二十七分三十秒二十微，小於半周歲二十六分五十二秒一十微。
units.en: from Wei 8° to Chou 8° took 182 days 14 hours 27 minutes 30 seconds 20 wei—26 minutes 52 seconds 10 wei shorter than half a year.
units.literal: from Wei eight degrees to Chou eight degrees, elapsed one hundred eighty-two days fourteen hours twenty-seven minutes thirty seconds twenty micro-units, less than half a tropical year by twenty-six minutes fifty-two seconds ten micro-units.

units.zh: 即知未宮七度在最高前如辰，八度在最高後如巳，丑宮七度在最卑前如午，八度在最卑後如未。
units.en: Thus Wei 7° lies before apogee (like chen), Wei 8° after it (like si); Chou 7° before perigee (like wu), Chou 8° after (like wei).
units.literal: Thus it is known Wei seven degrees lies before apogee like Chen hour, eight degrees after apogee like Si; Chou seven degrees before perigee like Wu, eight degrees after perigee like Wei hour.

units.zh: 以大小兩數相併，與辰巳或午未一度之比，同於大於半周歲之數與辰子或午丑之比，得四十四分三十六秒四十八微，與乙辰或丁午之七度相加，為高卑過二至之度。
units.en: Combining the two intervals proportionally yields 44′36″48‴; added to the 7° at solstice gives the longitude of apogee and perigee relative to the solstices.
units.literal: Combining the large and small numbers with the ratio of one degree at Chen-Si or Wu-Wei, as the excess over half a year relates to Chen-Zi or Wu-Chou, yields forty-four minutes thirty-six seconds forty-eight micro-units; adding to B-Chen or D-Wu's seven degrees gives the degrees of apogee and perigee past the solstices.

units.zh: 以最高卑每歲有行分，今合高卑以立算，定為本年中距過秋分之度。
units.en: Because apogee and perigee advance annually, they are combined to fix this year's mean-distance longitude past the autumn equinox.
units.literal: Since apogee and perigee each advance yearly, now combining high and low to establish calculation, fix this year mean distance past autumn equinox.

units.zh: 又用比例法推得秋分後丙午日巳正一刻十三分四十九秒過中距，若在黃道，應從最高子行九十度至寅，為辰宮七度四十四分三十六秒四十八微。
units.en: Proportion gives mean distance on bingwu after the autumn equinox at si 1 ke 13 fen 49 miao; on the ecliptic, 90° from apogee at Zi to Yin should place it at Chen 7°44′36″48‴.
units.literal: Again by proportion it is derived that after autumn equinox on bingwu day at si hour first quarter thirteen minutes forty-nine seconds mean distance was passed; if on the ecliptic, from apogee at Zi ninety degrees to Yin should be Chen palace seven degrees forty-four minutes thirty-six seconds forty-eight micro-units.

units.zh: 以實測求之，在申不及二度零三分零九秒四十微，檢其正切，得三五八四一六為設本天半徑一千萬之己甲兩心差。
units.en: Observation places it at Shen, 2°3′9″40‴ short; the tangent gives eccentricity 358416 for deferent radius 10,000,000.
units.literal: By actual measurement it falls at Shen, short of two degrees three minutes nine seconds forty micro-units; checking the tangent, 358416 is obtained as the Ji-Jia two-center difference for a deferent radius of ten million.

units.zh: 又本年申昜春園測得春分為二月癸巳亥初二刻六分四十七秒，立夏為三月己卯亥正二刻一分三十六秒，秋分為八月庚子申初二刻四分三秒，各計其相距之日，推得平行度以立算。
units.en: That year Changchun Garden timed the equinoxes and Start of Summer (2/ guisi hai 2 ke 6 fen 47 miao; 3/ jimao hai 2 ke 1 fen 36 miao; autumn equinox 8/ gengzi shen 2 ke 4 fen 3 miao) and derived mean motion from the elapsed days.
units.literal: Again this year Changchun Garden measured spring equinox on second month guisi at hai hour second quarter six minutes forty-seven seconds, Start of Summer on third month jimao at hai hour second quarter one minute thirty-six seconds, autumn equinox on eighth month gengzi at shen hour second quarter four minutes three seconds; counting intervening days for each, mean-motion degrees were derived to establish calculation.

units.zh: 如圖甲為地心，乙丙丁戊為黃道，戊為春分，巳為夏至，丙為秋分，庚為冬至，辛為立夏。
units.en: In the diagram: A is Earth; B–E mark the ecliptic—E spring equinox, Si summer solstice, C autumn equinox, Geng winter solstice, Xin Start of Summer.
units.literal: In the diagram A is geocenter; B-C-D-E are the ecliptic; E is spring equinox, Si summer solstice, C autumn equinox, Geng winter solstice, Xin Start of Summer.

units.zh: 子丑寅卯為不同心天，壬為天心，春分時太陽在子，立夏在癸，秋分在寅。
units.en: Zi, Chou, Yin, and Mao form the eccentric deferent, with Ren as its center; at the spring equinox the sun is at Zi, at Start of Summer at Gui, and at the autumn equinox at Yin.
units.literal: Zi-Chou-Yin-Mao are the eccentric deferent; Ren is its center; at spring equinox the sun is at Zi, at Start of Summer at Gui, at autumn equinox at Yin.

units.zh: 丑為最高，卯為最卑，求壬甲兩心差，並求辛甲乙角，為最高距立夏。
units.en: Chou is apogee, Mao perigee; find eccentricity Ren–Jia and angle Xin–Jia–B as apogee's offset from Start of Summer.
units.literal: Chou is apogee, Mao perigee; find the Ren-Jia two-center difference, and also angle Xin-Jia-B, as apogee's distance from Start of Summer.

units.zh: 取甲辰子平三角形及壬己甲勾股形，求得壬甲為三五八九七七，比前數多一千萬分之五百六十一。
units.en: Plane triangle Jia–Chen–Zi and right triangle Ren–Ji–Jia give eccentricity 358977—561 parts per 10,000,000 greater than before.
units.literal: Taking plane triangle Jia-Chen-Zi and right triangle Ren-Ji-Jia, Ren-Jia is found as 358977, five hundred sixty-one parts per ten million more than the previous number.

units.zh: 又求得甲角五十三度三十八分二十五秒五十五微，為最高距立夏，內減夏至距立夏四十五度，得最高過夏至後八度三十八分二十五秒五十五微，皆與前數不合。
units.en: Angle Jia comes to 53°38′25″55‴ as apogee from Start of Summer; subtracting the 45° from summer solstice to Start of Summer gives apogee 8°38′25″55‴ past summer solstice—both disagreeing with earlier results.
units.literal: Again angle Jia is found as fifty-three degrees thirty-eight minutes twenty-five seconds fifty-five micro-units as apogee from Start of Summer; subtracting summer solstice from Start of Summer forty-five degrees gives apogee eight degrees thirty-eight minutes twenty-five seconds fifty-five micro-units past summer solstice—all inconsistent with previous numbers.

units.zh: 於是定用於兩心差分設本輪、均輪之法。
units.en: The deferent–epicycle model based on eccentricity was therefore adopted.
units.literal: Thereupon it was fixed to use the method of setting deferent and epicycle from the two-center difference.

units.zh: 一，求最高行及本輪、均輪半徑以定盈縮。
units.en: Eighth, determine apogee motion and deferent and epicycle radii to fix the equation of center.
units.literal: Eighth, find apogee motion and deferent and epicycle radii to fix variation.

units.zh: 康熙十七年，測得最高在夏至後七度零四分零四秒。
units.en: In Kangxi 17 apogee was found at 7°4′4″ past the summer solstice.
units.literal: In Kangxi 17 apogee was measured at seven degrees four minutes four seconds after summer solstice.

units.zh: 五十六年，測得最高在夏至後七度四十三分四十九秒，約得每年東行一分一秒十微。
units.en: In year 56 it stood at 7°43′49″ past summer solstice, implying annual eastward motion of about 1′1″10‴.
units.literal: In year 56 apogee was measured at seven degrees forty-three minutes forty-nine seconds after summer solstice, yielding roughly eastward motion of one minute one second ten micro-units per year.

units.zh: 又定本天半徑為一千萬，用兩心差四分之三為本輪半徑，其一為均輪半徑。
units.en: The deferent radius was set at 10,000,000, with epicycle radius one-fourth and deferent radius three-fourths of the eccentricity.
units.literal: Again the deferent radius was fixed at ten million; three-fourths of the two-center difference is the deferent radius, one-fourth the epicycle radius.

units.zh: 如圖甲為地心，即本天心，乙丙丁戊為本天，注左右上下為本輪，最小圈為均輪，寅為太陽最高，辰為最卑。
units.en: A is Earth and deferent center; B–E mark the deferent path; the larger circle is the deferent, the smallest the epicycle; Yin is apogee, Chen perigee.
units.literal: In the diagram A is geocenter, that is deferent center; B-C-D-E are the deferent; the circles marked left, right, above, below are the deferent circle; the smallest circle is the epicycle; Yin is solar apogee, Chen perigee.

units.zh: 本輪心循本天周起冬至右旋為平行，均輪心循本輪周起最卑左旋為引數。
units.en: The deferent center moves clockwise from winter solstice as mean anomaly; the epicycle center moves counterclockwise from perigee as the argument.
units.literal: The deferent center revolves rightward around the deferent from winter solstice as mean motion; the epicycle center revolves leftward around the deferent from perigee as the argument.

units.zh: 二輪之行相較，即最卑行。
units.en: Their relative motion gives the anomaly of perigee.
units.literal: Comparing the two circles' motions gives perigee motion.

units.zh: 太陽循均輪周右旋，均輪在最高最卑，則最近於本輪心，如寅、辰；
units.en: The sun moves clockwise on the epicycle; at apogee and perigee the epicycle lies nearest the deferent center (Yin, Chen);
units.literal: The sun revolves rightward around the epicycle; when the epicycle is at apogee or perigee it is nearest the deferent center, as at Yin and Chen;

units.zh: 均輪在中距，則最遠於本輪心，如卯、己。
units.en: at mean distance it is farthest (Mao, Ji).
units.literal: when the epicycle is at mean distance it is farthest from the deferent center, as at Mao and Ji.

units.zh: 其行倍於均輪積點者，舊設不同心天，數與均輪不合。
units.en: The old eccentric deferent, whose motion was taken as twice the epicycle's advance, does not match epicycle theory numerically.
units.literal: Motion double the epicycle's accumulated point—the old eccentric deferent—does not agree numerically with the epicycle.

units.zh: 一，立矇影刻分限以定晨昏，測得在太陽未出之先、已入之後，距地平一十八度內。
units.en: Ninth, twilight limits for dawn and dusk were set at 18° below the horizon before sunrise and after sunset.
units.literal: Ninth, establish twilight quarter-limits to fix dawn and dusk; measurement shows within eighteen degrees of the horizon before the sun rises and after it sets.

units.zh: 月離立法之原：
units.en: Foundations of the lunar-motion methods:
units.literal: Origins of legislation for lunar motion:

units.zh: 一，求平行度。
units.en: First, determine mean motion.
units.literal: First, find mean motion.

units.zh: 依西人依巴谷法，定為一十二萬六千零七日四刻為兩月食各率齊同之距，會望轉終，皆復其始。
units.en: Following Hipparchus, 126,007 days 4 quarters is the period after which the two eclipse cycles, syzygies, and anomalistic revolutions all repeat.
units.literal: Following the Western scholar Hipparchus's method, it is fixed that 126,007 days four quarters is the commensurate interval for the two lunar-eclipse cycles to align, and conjunction, opposition, and anomalistic revolution all return to the start.

units.zh: 計其中積，凡為會望者四千二百六十七，為轉終者四千五百七十三。
units.en: Within this period there are 4,267 syzygies and 4,573 anomalistic revolutions.
units.literal: Counting the mean accumulation, syzygies number 4,267 and anomalistic revolutions 4,573.

units.zh: 置中積日刻為實，會望數除之，得會望策。
units.en: Dividing the total period by the syzygy count gives the synodic month.
units.literal: Set the mean accumulated days and quarters as dividend, divide by syzygy number, obtaining the syzygy rule.

units.zh: 乃以天周為實，會望策除之，為每日太陰平行距太陽之度。
units.en: Dividing the celestial circuit by this value gives the moon's daily mean elongation.
units.literal: Then take the celestial circuit as dividend, divide by the syzygy rule, as the moon's daily mean motion in longitude relative to the sun.

units.zh: 加太陽每日平行，為每日太陰平行白道經度。
units.en: Adding the sun's daily mean motion gives the moon's daily mean sidereal longitude on the white path.
units.literal: Add the sun's daily mean motion for the moon's daily mean white-path longitude.

units.zh: 又置中積日刻為實，轉終數除之，得轉終分。
units.en: Dividing the period by anomalistic revolutions gives the anomalistic month.
units.literal: Again set mean accumulated days and quarters as dividend, divide by anomalistic-revolution number, obtaining the anomalistic period.

units.zh: 置天周為實，轉終分除之，為每日太陰自行度。
units.en: Dividing the celestial circuit by this gives the moon's daily anomalistic motion.
units.literal: Set celestial circuit as dividend, divide by nodal period, as the moon's daily anomalistic motion.

units.zh: 每日白道經度與自行度相減，為每日最高行。
units.en: Subtracting anomalistic from sidereal motion gives daily apogee advance.
units.literal: Subtract daily anomalistic from daily white-path longitude for daily apogee motion.

units.zh: 一，推本輪半徑及最高以考遲疾。
units.en: Second, derive deferent radius and apogee to account for lunar anomaly.
units.literal: Second, derive deferent radius and apogee to examine slow and fast motion.

units.zh: 西人第谷測三月食，如第一食日躔鶉首宮七度三十五分四十七秒五十三微，月離星紀宮度分秒同，月行遲末限之初。
units.en: Tycho observed three eclipses: the first with the sun at Que 7°35′47″53‴ and the moon at Xingji with identical coordinates, at the start of the slow final limit.
units.literal: The Western scholar Tycho measured three eclipses: the first, sun in Que shou palace seven degrees thirty-five minutes forty-seven seconds fifty-three micro-units, moon in Xing ji palace same degrees minutes seconds, moon at the start of the slow final limit.

units.zh: 第二食日躔壽星宮初度，月離降婁宮度同，月行遲初限將半。
units.en: The second had the sun at Shouxing 0° and the moon at Jianglou with the same coordinates, moon near mid slow initial limit.
units.literal: The second eclipse, sun in Shou xing palace initial degree, moon in Jiang palace same, moon slow initial limit nearly half.

units.zh: 第三食日躔星紀宮二度五十四分零二秒四十九微，月離鶉首宮度分秒同，月行疾末限之初。
units.en: The third had the sun at Xingji 2°54′2″49‴ and the moon at Queshou with identical coordinates, at the start of the fast final limit.
units.literal: The third eclipse, sun in Xing ji palace two degrees fifty-four minutes two seconds forty-nine micro-units, moon in Que shou palace same degrees minutes seconds, moon at start of fast final limit.

units.zh: 第一食距第二食一千一百八十日二十二時一十四分零四秒，實行相距八十二度二十四分一十二秒零七微，平行相距八十度二十一分一十秒，自行相距三百零八度四十七分零七秒二十七微。
units.en: From the first to second eclipse: 1,180 days 22 hours 14 minutes 4 seconds; true motion 82°24′12″07‴; mean 80°21′10″; anomalistic 308°47′7″27‴.
units.literal: From first to second eclipse, 1,180 days 22 hours 14 minutes 4 seconds; true motion apart eighty-two degrees twenty-four minutes twelve seconds seven micro-units; mean motion eighty degrees twenty-one minutes ten seconds; anomalistic three hundred eight degrees forty-seven minutes seven seconds twenty-seven micro-units.

units.zh: 第二食距第三食一千九百一十八日二十三時零五分五十七秒，實行相距九十二度五十四分零二秒四十九微，平行相距八十五度零二十五秒，自行相距二百三十一度一十二分五十二秒三十三微。
units.en: From second to third: 1,918 days 23 hours 5 minutes 57 seconds; true 92°54′2″49‴; mean 85°0′25″; anomalistic 231°12′52″33‴.
units.literal: From second to third eclipse, 1,918 days 23 hours 5 minutes 57 seconds; true motion apart ninety-two degrees fifty-four minutes two seconds forty-nine micro-units; mean eighty-five degrees twenty-five seconds; anomalistic two hundred thirty-one degrees twelve minutes fifty-two seconds thirty-three micro-units.

units.zh: 用平三角形推得本輪半徑為本天半徑十萬分之八千七百，又推得最高行度，計至崇禎元年首朔月過最高三十七度三十四分三十四秒，然泛以三月食推之，本輪半徑之數不合，故設均輪。
units.en: Plane triangles give deferent radius 8,700 per 100,000 and apogee motion, placing the moon 37°34′34″ past apogee at the first new moon of Chongzhen 1; but the three-eclipse deferent radius disagrees, so an epicycle was added.
units.literal: By plane triangle the deferent radius is derived as 8,700 parts per 100,000 of deferent radius; apogee motion is also derived, reckoning to Chongzhen 1 first new moon apogee passage thirty-seven degrees thirty-four minutes thirty-four seconds; yet broadly from the three eclipses the deferent radius does not agree, hence the epicycle was introduced.

units.zh: 一，立四輪之行以定遲疾。
units.en: Third, establish the motions of the four circles to fix lunar anomaly.
units.literal: Third, establish the four circles' motions to fix slow and fast.

units.zh: 西人第谷徵諸實測，將本輪半徑三分之，存其二為本輪半徑，其一為均輪半徑。
units.en: Tycho Brahe, confirmed by observation, divided the deferent radius in three: two-thirds for the deferent, one-third for the epicycle.
units.literal: The Western scholar Tycho, verified against actual measurement, divided the deferent radius in three, keeping two-thirds as deferent radius and one-third as epicycle radius.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 定本輪心起本天冬至右旋為平行度，增一負均輪之圈。
units.en: The deferent center moves clockwise from winter solstice as mean anomaly, with an added counter-rotating epicycle circle.
units.literal: Fix the deferent center starting from winter solstice on the deferent, revolving rightward as mean motion, and add a negative epicycle circle.

units.zh: 其半徑為新本輪半徑，加一次輪半徑之數。
units.en: Its radius equals the new deferent radius plus the secondary-deferent radius.
units.literal: Its radius is the new deferent radius plus the secondary-deferent radius.

units.zh: 其心同本輪之心。
units.en: It shares the deferent center.
units.literal: Its center is the same as the deferent center.

units.zh: 本輪負而行，不自行，移均輪心從最高左旋，行於此圈之周，為自行引數。
units.en: The deferent rotates counter to mean motion; the epicycle center moves counterclockwise from apogee around this circle as the anomalistic argument.
units.literal: The deferent moves negatively without self-motion; the epicycle center is shifted from apogee leftward, traveling this circle's circumference as the anomalistic argument.

units.zh: 第谷又將次輪設於地心，而增次均輪。
units.en: Tycho also placed a secondary deferent at Earth and added a secondary epicycle.
units.literal: Tycho also set the secondary deferent at the geocenter and added a secondary epicycle.

units.zh: 本法易之，定次輪心行均輪周，從最近右旋為倍引數，其半徑為本天半徑千萬分之二十一萬七千。
units.en: The present system revises this: the secondary-deferent center moves on the epicycle, clockwise from perigee as the double argument, with radius 217,000 per 10,000,000.
units.literal: The present method changes this: fix the secondary-deferent center to travel the epicycle circumference, revolving rightward from nearest point as double argument; its radius is 217,000 parts per ten million of deferent radius.

units.zh: 次均輪心行次輪周，起於朔望，從次輪最近地心點右旋，行太陰距太陽之倍度為倍離，其半徑為本天半徑千萬分之一十一萬七千五百。
units.en: The secondary-epicycle center moves on the secondary deferent from syzygy, clockwise from Earth's nearest point, through double elongation, with radius 117,500 per 10,000,000.
units.literal: The secondary-epicycle center travels the secondary-deferent circumference, starting at syzygy, revolving rightward from the secondary-deferent's nearest point to Earth, traveling double the moon's elongation as double distance; its radius is 117,500 parts per ten million.

units.zh: 太陰行次均輪之周，從次均輪最下左旋，亦行倍離。
units.en: The moon moves counterclockwise on the secondary epicycle from its lowest point, likewise through double elongation.
units.literal: The moon travels the secondary-epicycle circumference, leftward from the secondary-epicycle's lowest point, also through double distance.

units.zh: 如圖甲為地心，即本天心，乙丙丁為本天之一弧，丙甲為半徑，戊為半輪最高，癸為最卑，酉為負圈最高，丑為最卑，壬為均輪最遠，辛為最近，寅為次輪最遠，亥為最近，土為次均輪最上，木為最下，即均輪心在最高又當朔望之象。
units.en: A is Earth and deferent center; B–D mark a deferent arc; Wu and Gui are secondary-deferent apogee and perigee; You and Chou the counter-epicycle extremes; Ren and Xin the epicycle extremes; Yin and Hai the secondary-deferent extremes; Tu and Mu the secondary-epicycle extremes—here with the epicycle at apogee and syzygy.
units.literal: In the diagram A is geocenter, deferent center; B-C-D are an arc of the deferent, C-A the radius; Wu is secondary-deferent apogee, Gui perigee; You negative-circle apogee, Chou perigee; Ren epicycle farthest, Xin nearest; Yin secondary-deferent farthest, Hai nearest; Tu secondary-epicycle top, Mu bottom—when the epicycle center is at apogee and also at syzygy.

units.zh: 又圖太陰在戌，是均輪既左旋，又當朔望之象。
units.en: In another diagram the moon is at Xu: the epicycle has rotated counterclockwise and again stands at syzygy.
units.literal: In another diagram the moon is at Xu: the epicycle has already turned leftward and is again at syzygy.

units.zh: 其得次輪、次均輪半徑於上下弦，當自行三宮或九宮時累測之，得極大均數七度二十五分四十六秒。
units.en: At first and last quarter, when anomalistic motion stood at 3 or 9 mansions, repeated measurements gave a maximum equation of 7°25′46″, from which secondary-deferent and secondary-epicycle radii were derived.
units.literal: Secondary-deferent and secondary-epicycle radii were obtained at first and last quarter, when anomalistic motion was at three or nine mansions, by repeated measurement, yielding maximum equation seven degrees twenty-five minutes forty-six seconds.

units.zh: 其切線一百三十萬四千，內減本輪均輪★半徑，餘半之，即次輪半徑。
units.en: The tangent 1,304,000 minus the combined deferent and epicycle radii, halved, gives the secondary-deferent radius.
units.literal: Its tangent 1,304,000, minus deferent and epicycle radii combined, halved, gives the secondary-deferent radius.

units.zh: 於兩弦及朔望之間，當自行三宮或九宮時累測之，均數常與推算不合，差至四十一分零二秒，依法求其半徑，得次均輪半徑。
units.en: Between quarters and syzygies at 3 or 9 mansions, repeated observation showed discrepancies up to 41′2″; the secondary-epicycle radius was then derived by the standard method.
units.literal: Between the quarters and syzygies, when anomalistic motion was at three or nine mansions, repeated measurement showed the equation often disagreed with calculation by as much as forty-one minutes two seconds; by the method its radius was found as the secondary-epicycle radius.

units.zh: 圖形尚無資料
units.en: Diagram not yet available
units.literal: Diagram data not yet available

units.zh: 一，以兩月食定交周。
units.en: Fourth, establish the nodal month from two lunar eclipses.
units.literal: Fourth, fix the nodal period from two lunar eclipses.

units.zh: 順治十三年十一月庚申望子正後十八時四十四分十五秒，月食十五分四十七秒，在黃道南，日纏星紀宮十度三十九分，在最卑後三度四十九分，月自行為三宮二十七度四十六分。
units.en: On gengshen full moon, 11th month Shunzhi 13, at zi +18h44m15s, a lunar eclipse of 15′47″ south of the ecliptic; the sun at Xingji 10°39′, 3°49′ past perigee; lunar anomaly 3 mansions 27°46′.
units.literal: Shunzhi 13, eleventh month gengshen full moon, zi hour eighteen hours forty-four minutes fifteen seconds after midnight, lunar eclipse fifteen minutes forty-seven seconds, south of ecliptic; sun at Xingji 10°39′, three degrees forty-nine minutes after perigee; moon anomalistic motion three mansions twenty-seven degrees forty-six minutes.

units.zh: 康熙十三年十二月丙午望子正後三時二十三分二十六秒，月食十五分五十秒，在黃道南，日纏星紀宮二十一度五十二分，在最卑後十四度二十一分，月自行為三宮二十五度二十四分。
units.en: On bingwu full moon, 12th month Kangxi 13, at zi +3h23m26s, a lunar eclipse of 15′50″ south of the ecliptic; the sun at Xingji 21°52′, 14°21′ past perigee; lunar anomaly 3 mansions 25°24′.
units.literal: Kangxi 13, twelfth month bingwu full moon, zi hour three hours twenty-three minutes twenty-six seconds after midnight, lunar eclipse fifteen minutes fifty seconds, south of ecliptic; sun at Xingji 21°52′, fourteen degrees twenty-one minutes after perigee; moon anomalistic three mansions twenty-five degrees twenty-four minutes.

units.zh: 相距中積二百二十三月。
units.en: The mean interval between them is 223 months.
units.literal: Mean interval between them: two hundred twenty-three months.

units.zh: 用西人依巴谷朔策定數五千四百五十八為一率，交終定數五千九百二十三為二率，二百二十三月為三率，得四率二百四十一又五千四百五十八分之五千四百五十一，為兩次月食相距之交終數。
units.en: With Hipparchus's synodic ratio 5458 and nodal ratio 5923, 223 months yields 241 + 5451/5458 nodal revolutions between the eclipses.
units.literal: Using Hipparchus's synodic constant 5458 as first ratio, nodal-revolution constant 5923 as second, 223 months as third, yields fourth ratio 241 and 5451/5458 as nodal revolutions between the two eclipses.

units.zh: 又以兩次月食相距中積六千五百八十五日零八時三十九分十秒，與每日太陰平行經度相乘，以交終數除之，得一百二十九萬零八百一十二秒小餘八七九五九八，為每一交行度。
units.en: Multiplying the 6585-day interval by daily lunar mean motion and dividing by nodal revolutions gives nodal advance 1,290,812″ with remainder 879598.
units.literal: Multiplying mean interval 6585 days 8 hours 39 minutes 10 seconds by daily lunar mean longitude and dividing by nodal revolutions gives 1,290,812 seconds remainder 879598 as each nodal advance.

units.zh: 與周天秒數相減，餘五千一百八十七秒小餘一二０四０二，為每一交退行度。
units.en: Subtracting from a full circle leaves nodal retrograde motion 5187″ with remainder 120402.
units.literal: Subtract from full-circle seconds; remainder 5187 seconds remainder 120402 is each nodal retrograde motion.

units.zh: 又以交終數除兩次月食相距中積日分，得二十七日二一二二三三，為交周日分。
units.en: Dividing the interval by nodal revolutions gives the draconic month as 27.212233 days.
units.literal: Dividing mean interval by nodal revolutions gives 27.212233 days as the nodal month.

units.zh: 乃以交周日分除每一交退行度，得三分十秒三十七微，為兩交每日退行度。
units.en: Dividing nodal retrograde by the draconic month gives daily nodal regression of 3′10″37‴.
units.literal: Dividing each nodal retrograde by the nodal month gives three minutes ten seconds thirty-seven micro-units as daily nodal retrograde between two nodes.

units.zh: 與太陰每日平行相加，得十三度十三分四十五秒三十八微，為太陰每日距交行。
units.en: Adding daily lunar mean motion gives daily motion relative to the node as 13°13′45″38‴.
units.literal: Add daily lunar mean motion to obtain thirteen degrees thirteen minutes forty-five seconds thirty-eight micro-units as daily motion relative to the node.

units.zh: 因兩次月自行差二度半，食分差三秒，故比依巴谷所定距交行差一微，仍用依巴谷所定數。
units.en: Anomalistic difference of 2½° and eclipse-magnitude difference of 3″ make nodal motion differ from Hipparchus by 1‴; Hipparchus's figure is retained.
units.literal: Because the two eclipses differ in anomalistic motion by two and a half degrees and eclipse magnitude by three seconds, daily motion relative to the node differs from Hipparchus by one micro-unit; Hipparchus's value is still used.

units.zh: 一，求黃白大距度及交均以定交行。
units.en: Fifth, determine maximum lunar latitude and nodal limits to fix nodal motion.
units.literal: Fifth, find the great ecliptic-lunar distance and nodal limits to fix nodal motion.

units.zh: 於月離黃道鶉首宮初度，又在黃道北距交適足九十度時，俟至子午線上測之，得地平高度，減去赤道高及黃赤距緯度。
units.en: When the moon is at Queshou 0° with latitude 90° from the node north of the ecliptic, measure its meridian altitude and subtract equatorial altitude and ecliptic declination.
units.literal: When the moon leaves the ecliptic at Queshou initial degree and north of the ecliptic is exactly ninety degrees from the node, wait until it reaches the meridian and measure altitude; subtract equatorial altitude and ecliptic declination.

units.zh: 一在朔望時，得大距四度五十八分三十秒；
units.en: At syzygy, maximum latitude is 4°58′30″;
units.literal: once at syzygy, obtaining great distance four degrees fifty-eight minutes thirty seconds;

units.zh: 一在上下弦時，得大距五度一十七分三十秒，以之立法。
units.en: at quadrature, 5°17′30″—and on these figures the method was established.
units.literal: once at first and last quarter, obtaining great distance five degrees seventeen minutes thirty seconds—by these the method was established.

units.zh: 如圖甲為黃極，乙丙丁戊為黃道，用兩距度相加折半，為黃白大距之中數，為半徑如巳甲，作本輪如巳庚辛壬。
units.en: A is the ecliptic pole and B–E the ecliptic; the mean maximum latitude is half the sum of the two values; radius Si–Jia defines deferent Si–Geng–Xin–Ren.
units.literal: In the diagram A is the ecliptic pole, B-C-D-E the ecliptic; add the two distances and halve for the mean great ecliptic-lunar distance; with radius like Si-Jia, make the deferent like Si-Geng-Xin-Ren.

units.zh: 又取兩距度相減折半為半徑如巳癸，作均輪如癸子丑寅。
units.en: Half the difference of the two values gives radius Si–Gui and epicycle Gui–Zi–Chou–Yin.
units.literal: Subtract the two distances, halve, as radius like Si-Gui, making the epicycle like Gui-Zi-Chou-Yin.

units.zh: 其心循本輪左旋，每日行三分十秒有餘。
units.en: Its center moves counterclockwise on the deferent at slightly more than 3′10″ per day.
units.literal: Its center travels the deferent leftward, daily motion a little over three minutes ten seconds.

units.zh: 白道極循均輪，起最近，左旋，行倍離之度。
units.en: The lunar pole moves counterclockwise on the epicycle from perigee through double elongation.
units.literal: The white-path pole travels the epicycle, starting at nearest, leftward, through double elongation.

units.zh: 行至癸，則大距為乙卯；
units.en: At Gui, the maximum latitude is Yi–Mao;
units.literal: reaching Gui, great distance is Yi-Mao;

units.zh: 行至丑，則大距為乙辰。
units.en: at Chou it is Yi–Chen.
units.literal: reaching Chou, great distance is Yi-Chen.

units.zh: 行子丑寅之半交行疾，行寅癸子之半交行遲。
units.en: From Zi through Chou to Yin nodal motion is fast; from Yin through Gui to Zi it is slow.
units.literal: Traversing Zi-Chou-Yin half the nodal motion is fast; traversing Yin-Gui-Zi half is slow.

units.zh: 一，求地半徑差如太陽。
units.en: Sixth, determine lunar parallax by the same method as for the sun.
units.literal: Sixth, find terrestrial semidiameter parallax as for the sun.

units.zh: 申昜春園測得太陰高六十二度四十分五十一秒四十三微，同時於廣東廣州府測得太陰高七十九度四十七分二十六秒一十二微，於時月自行三宮初度，月距日一百八十度，以之立法，用平三角形推得地半徑與太陰在中距時距地心之比例，為一與五十六又百分之七十二。
units.en: Changchun Garden recorded the moon at 62°40′51″43‴ and Guangzhou prefecture in Guangdong at 79°47′26″12‴ when elongation was 180° and anomaly at 3 mansions 0°; plane triangles give Earth's radius to the moon's mean distance as 1:56.72.
units.literal: Shenyang Spring Garden measured the moon at sixty-two degrees forty minutes fifty-one seconds forty-three micro-units; Guangzhou simultaneously at seventy-nine degrees forty-seven minutes twenty-six seconds twelve micro-units; at the time anomalistic motion was three mansions initial degree, elongation one hundred eighty degrees; by this the ratio of terrestrial radius to moon's mean-distance from geocenter was derived as one to fifty-six and seventy-two hundredths.

units.zh: 依此法於月自行初宮初度月距日九十度時測之，求得地半徑與太陰在最高時距地心之比例，為一與六十一又百分之九十八。
units.en: At first mansion 0° with elongation 90°, the same method gives apogee distance ratio 1:61.98.
units.literal: By this method, measured when anomalistic motion was initial mansion initial degree and elongation ninety degrees, the ratio at apogee was one to sixty-one and ninety-eight hundredths.

units.zh: 又於月自行六宮初度月距日九十度時測之，求得地半徑與太陰在最卑時距地心之比例，為一與五十三又百分之七十一。
units.en: At six mansions 0° with elongation 90°, perigee distance ratio is 1:53.71.
units.literal: Again measured at six mansions initial degree and elongation ninety degrees, perigee ratio one to fifty-three and seventy-one hundredths.

units.zh: 復用平三角形逐度皆推得地半徑差。
units.en: Plane triangles then give parallax for every degree.
units.literal: Again plane triangles derive parallax for every degree.

units.zh: 一，考隱見遲疾以辨朓朒。
units.en: Seventh, examine visibility and lunar speed to distinguish the waxing and waning phases.
units.literal: Seventh, examine visibility timing and slow-fast motion to distinguish waxing and waning.

units.zh: 一驗在春分前後各三宮，黃道斜升而正降，日入時月在地平上高，朔後疾見，在秋分前後各三宮，黃道正升而斜降，日入時月在地平上低，朔後遲見，晦前隱遲、隱早反是。
units.en: Around the spring equinox the ecliptic rises obliquely and sets vertically: at sunset the moon stands high and first visibility after new moon comes early. Around the autumn equinox the ecliptic rises vertically and sets obliquely: the moon is low at sunset and first visibility comes late; last visibility before conjunction shows the opposite pattern.
units.literal: One test: three mansions before and after spring equinox, ecliptic obliquely rising and directly setting—at sunset the moon is high above the horizon, fast visibility after new moon; three mansions before and after autumn equinox, ecliptic directly rising and obliquely setting—moon low at sunset, slow visibility after new moon; before last day of month slow hiding and early hiding are reversed.

units.zh: 一驗距黃道北，見早隱遲，距黃道南反是。
units.en: North of the ecliptic visibility comes early and hiding late; south of the ecliptic, the reverse.
units.literal: One test: north of the ecliptic, early visibility and late hiding; south of the ecliptic the reverse.

units.zh: 一驗視行遲，隱見俱遲；
units.en: When apparent motion is slow, both visibility and hiding are delayed;
units.literal: One test: when apparent motion is slow, both hiding and visibility are slow;

units.zh: 視行早，隱見俱早。
units.en: when it is fast, both come early.
units.literal: when apparent motion is fast, both are fast.

units.zh: 交食立法之原：
units.en: Foundations of the eclipse methods:
units.literal: Origins of legislation for eclipses:

units.zh: 一，求日月視徑以定食分淺深。
units.en: First, determine the apparent diameters of the sun and moon to fix eclipse magnitude.
units.literal: First, find the sun and moon's apparent diameters to fix eclipse magnitude and depth.

units.zh: 用正表、倒表，各取日中之影，求其高度。
units.en: Upright and inverted gnomons each measure the noon shadow to determine altitude.
units.literal: Use upright and inverted gnomons, each taking the noon shadow to find altitude.

units.zh: 兩高度之較以為太陽視徑。
units.en: The difference between the two altitudes gives the sun's apparent diameter.
units.literal: The difference of the two altitudes is taken as the sun's apparent diameter.

units.zh: 數年精測，得太陽最高之徑為二十九分五十九秒，最卑之徑為三十一分零五秒。
units.en: Years of precise measurement gave solar diameter 29′59″ at apogee and 31′5″ at perigee.
units.literal: After years of precise measurement, the sun's diameter at apogee is twenty-nine minutes fifty-nine seconds, at perigee thirty-one minutes five seconds.

units.zh: 用牆為表，以其西界當正午線，人在表北，依不動之處，候太陰之西周切於正午線，看時辰表時刻；
units.en: A wall serves as the marker, its west edge on the meridian; standing north at a fixed point, note the time when the moon's western limb touches the meridian;
units.literal: Use a wall as gnomon, its west edge on the noon line; stand north of the wall at a fixed spot, wait until the moon's western limb touches the noon line, and note the clock;

units.zh: 俟太陰體過完，其東周才離正午線，復看時辰表時刻；
units.en: then note when the moon's body has passed and its eastern limb leaves the meridian;
units.literal: wait until the moon's body has passed and its eastern limb just leaves the noon line, and note the clock again;

units.zh: 與前相減，變度以為太陰視徑。
units.en: the elapsed time converted to degrees gives the moon's apparent diameter.
units.literal: subtract the former, convert to degrees as the moon's apparent diameter.

units.zh: 數年精測，得太陰最高之徑為三十一分四十七秒，最卑之徑為三十三分四十二秒。
units.en: Years of measurement gave lunar diameter 31′47″ at apogee and 33′42″ at perigee.
units.literal: After years of precise measurement, lunar diameter at apogee thirty-one minutes forty-seven seconds, at perigee thirty-three minutes forty-two seconds.

units.zh: 一，求地影半徑以定光分。
units.en: Second, determine the earth-shadow radius to fix the solar light extension.
units.literal: Second, find the earth-shadow radius to fix the light extension.

units.zh: 地半徑與太陽太陰距地心既得比例，日月視徑又得真數，太陽、太陰自高至卑視徑地半徑與太陽、太陰實徑比例。
units.en: With Earth-radius ratios to the sun and moon and true apparent diameters known, the full range of solar and lunar apparent and true diameters follows.
units.literal: Once ratios of terrestrial radius to sun and moon distances and true apparent diameters are known, the ratios from apogee to perigee of apparent diameter, terrestrial radius, and true diameter for sun and moon are obtained.

units.zh: 日食，人在地面見與不見。
units.en: For solar eclipses, whether observers on Earth's surface see them or not.
units.literal: For solar eclipse, whether people on the surface see it or not.

units.zh: 月食，太陽照地背成黑影，太陽大而地小，故成錐形。
units.en: For lunar eclipses, sunlight cast behind Earth forms a conical shadow because the sun is larger than Earth.
units.literal: For lunar eclipse, sunlight on Earth's back forms a black shadow; the sun is large and Earth small, hence a cone.

units.zh: 太陽有高卑，故地影有長短廣狹；
units.en: The sun's varying distance makes the shadow longer or shorter and wider or narrower;
units.literal: The sun has apogee and perigee, so the earth-shadow has varying length and width;

units.zh: 太陰有高卑，故入影有淺深；
units.en: the moon's varying distance makes penetration shallow or deep;
units.literal: the moon has apogee and perigee, so entry into shadow has shallow and deep degrees;

units.zh: 皆可預推而以立法。
units.en: all of which can be predicted and built into the methods.
units.literal: all can be predicted in advance and legislated thereby.

units.zh: 地影半徑常大於實測，康熙五十六年八月戊戌月食，其實引為二宮三度四十一分零三秒，距地心五十七地半徑零百分之四十一。
units.en: Calculated shadow radius usually exceeds observation; the wuxu lunar eclipse of the 8th month, Kangxi 56, had true anomaly 2 mansions 3°41′3″ and geocentric distance 57.41 Earth radii.
units.literal: Earth-shadow radius is usually larger than actual measurement; Kangxi 56 eighth month wuxu lunar eclipse, true argument two mansions three degrees forty-one minutes three seconds, distance from geocenter fifty-seven terrestrial radii and forty-one hundredths.

units.zh: 測得緯度在黃道北三十六分十八秒，月半徑為十六分十秒，食分為二十三分三十秒，乃以黃緯求得白道緯為食甚，距緯與食分相加，內減月半徑，餘四十三分四十六秒，為地影半徑。
units.en: Observation gave latitude 36′18″ N of the ecliptic, lunar semidiameter 16′10″, magnitude 23′30″; from ecliptic latitude at greatest eclipse, adding latitude and magnitude and subtracting lunar radius yields shadow radius 43′46″.
units.literal: Measured latitude north of ecliptic thirty-six minutes eighteen seconds, lunar semidiameter sixteen minutes ten seconds, eclipse magnitude twenty-three minutes thirty seconds; from ecliptic latitude obtain white-path latitude at greatest eclipse; add latitude distance and magnitude, subtract lunar semidiameter within, remainder forty-three minutes forty-six seconds as earth-shadow radius.

units.zh: 若依推算，太陽在最高，太陰在中距，地影半徑應得四十八分三十四秒，以實測之數率之，應得四十四分四十三秒，所差三分五十一秒。
units.en: Calculation with the sun at apogee and moon at mean distance gives 48′34″; scaled to observation it should be 44′43″—a discrepancy of 3′51″.
units.literal: By calculation with sun at apogee and moon at mean distance, shadow radius should be forty-eight minutes thirty-four seconds; scaled to actual measurement should be forty-four minutes forty-three seconds; difference three minutes fifty-one seconds.

units.zh: 因驗得太陽光芒溢於原體之外，能侵削地影。
units.en: Observation showed that solar radiance extends beyond the disk and erodes the shadow.
units.literal: Verification showed solar radiance extends beyond the original body and can erode the earth-shadow.

units.zh: 以實測比算，定太陽之光分為地半徑之六倍又百分之三十七。
units.en: Comparing observation with theory fixes the solar light extension at 6.37 Earth radii.
units.literal: Comparing actual measurement with calculation, fix the sun's light extension as six and thirty-seven hundredths times the terrestrial radius.

units.zh: 如圖甲為地心，戊己為地徑，乙丁為太陽所照影，末當至於庚。
units.en: A is Earth's center, Wu–Ji its diameter, Yi–Ding the solar shadow extending to Geng.
units.literal: In the diagram A is geocenter, Wu-Ji Earth's diameter, Yi-Ding the shadow cast by the sun, whose end should reach Geng.

units.en: Xin–Ren marks the encroaching light that narrows the shadow until it vanishes at Chou.

units.zh: 五星行立法之原：
units.en: Foundations of the planetary-motion methods:
units.literal: Origins of legislation for the five planets' motion:

units.zh: 一，求土星平行度。
units.en: First, determine Saturn's mean motion.
units.literal: First, find Saturn's mean motion.

units.zh: 古測定二萬一千五百五十一日又十分日之三，距恆星之度分等，距太陽之遠近又等。
units.en: Ancient measurement fixed the period at 21,551.3 days, with equal sidereal motion and equal solar distance.
units.literal: Ancient measurement fixed 21,551 days and three-tenths of a day, equal in degrees from fixed stars and equal in distance from the sun.

units.zh: 土星行次輪會日、沖日各五十七次。
units.en: Saturn completes 57 conjunctions and 57 oppositions per secondary-deferent cycle.
units.literal: Saturn travels the secondary deferent fifty-seven conjunctions and fifty-seven oppositions.

units.zh: 置中積日分為實，星行次輪周數五十七為法，除之得周率。
units.en: Dividing the total period by 57 secondary-deferent revolutions gives the cycle rate.
units.literal: Set mean accumulated days as dividend, fifty-seven secondary-deferent revolutions as divisor, obtaining the cycle rate.

units.zh: 乃以每周三百六十度為實，周率除之，為每日距太陽之行。
units.en: Dividing 360° by this rate gives Saturn's daily motion relative to the sun.
units.literal: Then take 360 degrees per cycle as dividend, divide by cycle rate, as daily motion relative to the sun.

units.zh: 與太陽每日平行相減，得土星每日平行。
units.en: Subtracting the sun's daily mean motion gives Saturn's daily sidereal mean motion.
units.literal: Subtract the sun's daily mean motion to obtain Saturn's daily mean motion.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，用三次沖日求土星本輪、均輪半徑及最高以定盈縮。
units.en: Second, use three oppositions to determine Saturn's deferent and epicycle radii and apogee for the equation of center.
units.literal: Second, use three oppositions to find Saturn's deferent and epicycle radii and apogee to fix variation.

units.zh: 明萬曆間，西人第谷測土星三次沖日。
units.en: During the Wanli era Tycho Brahe observed Saturn at three oppositions.
units.literal: During Wanli, the Western scholar Tycho measured Saturn at three oppositions.

units.zh: 如第一次日躔娵訾宮一度零三分二十七秒，土星在鶉尾宮度分秒同；
units.en: First opposition: sun at Juzi 1°3′27″, Saturn at Chunwei with identical coordinates;
units.literal: First opposition: sun at Juzi palace 1°3′27″, Saturn at Chunwei palace same degrees minutes seconds;

units.en: second: sun at Juzi 21°47′39″, Saturn at Chunwei likewise;
units.literal: second: sun at Juzi 21°47′39″, Saturn at Chunwei same;

units.literal: third: sun at Jiang 16°51′28″, Saturn at Shouxing same.

units.literal: second to third: 755 days 20 hours 31 minutes; true 25°3′49″, mean 25°19′16″.

units.en: Eccentric-circle plane triangles give eccentricity 1,162,000 per 10,000,000—deferent 865,587 and epicycle 296,413.
units.literal: Using eccentric circles and plane triangles, eccentricity 1,162,000 per ten million was derived, split into deferent 865,587 and epicycle 296,413.

units.en: Apogee in Wanli 18 stood at Ximu 26°20′27″, advancing 1′20″12‴ annually.
units.literal: Apogee in Wanli 18 was at Ximu 26°20′27″, apogee advancing 1′20″12‴ per year.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求土星次輪半徑以定順逆。
units.en: Third, determine Saturn's secondary-deferent radius to account for retrogradation.
units.literal: Third, find Saturn's secondary-deferent radius to fix direct and retrograde motion.

units.zh: 西人第谷測得次輪半徑為本天半徑千萬分之一百零四萬二千六百。
units.en: Tycho found the secondary-deferent radius at 1,042,600 per 10,000,000.
units.literal: Tycho measured secondary-deferent radius as 1,042,600 per ten million of deferent radius.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 定本輪心從本天冬至右旋為平行度，均輪心從本輪最高左旋為自行引數，次輪心從均輪最近右旋為倍引數，星從次輪最遠右旋，行本輪心距太陽之度。
units.en: The deferent center moves clockwise from winter solstice; the epicycle center counterclockwise from apogee; the secondary-deferent center clockwise from perigee; the planet clockwise from apogee on the secondary deferent along the deferent's solar distance.
units.literal: Fix deferent center clockwise from winter solstice as mean motion; epicycle center counterclockwise from apogee as anomalistic argument; secondary-deferent center clockwise from nearest as double argument; planet clockwise from farthest on secondary deferent, traveling deferent-center distance from sun.

units.zh: 本輪、均輪之面與本天平行，次輪之面與黃道平行。
units.en: Deferent and epicycle lie in the deferent plane; the secondary deferent lies in the ecliptic plane.
units.literal: Deferent and epicycle planes parallel the deferent; secondary-deferent plane parallel the ecliptic.

units.zh: 如圖甲為地心，即本天心，乙丙丁為本天之一弧，丙甲為半徑，戊為本輪最高，己為最卑，庚為均輪最遠，辛為最近，壬為次輪最遠，癸為最近。
units.en: A is Earth; B–D mark a deferent arc; Wu and Ji are deferent apogee and perigee; Geng and Xin the epicycle extremes; Ren and Gui the secondary-deferent extremes.
units.literal: A is geocenter, deferent center; B-C-D a deferent arc, C-A radius; Wu deferent apogee, Ji perigee; Geng epicycle farthest, Xin nearest; Ren secondary-deferent farthest, Gui nearest.

units.zh: 一，求木星平行度。
units.en: First, determine Jupiter's mean motion.
units.literal: First, find Jupiter's mean motion.

units.zh: 古測定二萬五千九百二十七日又千分日之六百一十七，木星行次輪會日沖日皆六十五次。
units.en: Ancient measurement fixed the period at 25,927.617 days, with 65 conjunctions and 65 oppositions per secondary-deferent cycle.
units.literal: Ancient measurement fixed 25,927 days and 617 thousandths of a day; Jupiter's secondary deferent has sixty-five conjunctions and oppositions each.

units.zh: 置中積日分為實，星行次輪周數六十五為法，除之得周率。
units.en: Dividing the total period by 65 revolutions gives the cycle rate.
units.literal: Set mean accumulated days as dividend, sixty-five revolutions as divisor, obtaining cycle rate.

units.zh: 以每周三百六十度為實，周率除之，得每日木星距太陽之行。
units.en: Dividing 360° by this rate gives Jupiter's daily motion relative to the sun.
units.literal: Take 360 degrees per cycle as dividend, divide by cycle rate, as Jupiter's daily motion relative to the sun.

units.zh: 與每日太陽平行相減，為每日木星平行度。
units.en: Subtracting the sun's daily mean motion gives Jupiter's daily sidereal mean motion.
units.literal: Subtract the sun's daily mean motion to obtain Jupiter's daily mean motion.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.literal: Diagram data not yet available
