units.en: Second, use three oppositions to determine Jupiter's deferent and epicycle radii and apogee for the equation of center.
units.literal: Second, use three oppositions to find Jupiter's deferent and epicycle radii and apogee to fix variation.

units.zh: 明萬曆間，西人第谷測木星三次沖日，如第一次日躔鶉尾宮七度三十一分四十九秒，木星在娵訾宮度分秒同；
units.en: During the Wanli era Tycho observed Jupiter at three oppositions: first, sun at Weiwei 7°31′49″, Jupiter at Zi with identical coordinates;
units.literal: During Wanli, Tycho measured Jupiter at three oppositions: first, sun at Weiwei 7°31′49″, Jupiter at Zi same degrees minutes seconds;

units.zh: 第二次日躔大火宮二十度五十六分，木星在大梁宮度分同；
units.en: second, sun at Dahu 20°56′, Jupiter at Daliang likewise;
units.literal: second, sun at Dahu 20°56′, Jupiter at Daliang same;

units.zh: 第三次日躔析木宮二十五度五十二分二十七秒，木星在實沈宮度分秒同。
units.en: third, sun at Ximu 25°52′27″, Jupiter at Zhenchen with identical coordinates.
units.literal: third, sun at Ximu 25°52′27″, Jupiter at Zhenchen same.

units.zh: 第一次距第二次八百零四日一十五時三十五分，實行相距七十三度二十四分十一秒，平行相距六十六度五十三分二十秒；
units.en: From first to second: 804 days 15h35m; true motion 73°24′11″, mean 66°53′20″;
units.literal: First to second: 804 days 15 hours 35 minutes; true 73°24′11″, mean 66°53′20″;

units.zh: 第二次距第三次三百九十九日一十四時四十四分，實行相距三十四度五十六分二十七秒，平行相距三十三度十三分零八秒。
units.en: from second to third: 399 days 14h44m; true 34°56′27″, mean 33°13′8″.
units.literal: second to third: 399 days 14 hours 44 minutes; true 34°56′27″, mean 33°13′8″.

units.zh: 用不同心圈取平三角形，推得兩心差，為本天半徑千萬分之九十五萬三千三百，析為本輪半徑七十萬五千三百二十，均輪半徑二十四萬七千九百八十。
units.en: Eccentricity 953,300 per 10,000,000—deferent 705,320 and epicycle 247,980.
units.literal: Eccentricity 953,300 per ten million; deferent 705,320, epicycle 247,980.

units.zh: 又推得萬曆二十八年最高在壽星宮八度四十分，每年最高行五十七秒五十二微。
units.en: Apogee in Wanli 28 stood at Shouxing 8°40′, advancing 57″52‴ annually.
units.literal: Wanli 28 apogee at Shouxing 8°40′, advancing 57″52‴ per year.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求木星次輪半徑以定順逆。
units.en: Third, determine Jupiter's secondary-deferent radius to account for retrogradation.
units.literal: Third, find Jupiter's secondary-deferent radius for retrogradation.

units.zh: 西人第谷測得木星次輪半徑為本天半徑千萬分之一百九十二萬九千四百八十。
units.en: Tycho found the secondary-deferent radius at 1,929,480 per 10,000,000.
units.literal: Tycho found secondary-deferent radius 1,929,480 per ten million.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 定諸輪左右旋起數及輪面如土星。
units.en: Wheel directions and orbital planes are fixed as for Saturn.
units.literal: Fix wheel directions and planes as for Saturn.

units.zh: 一，求火星平行度。
units.en: First, determine Mars's mean motion.
units.literal: First, find Mars's mean motion.

units.zh: 古測定二萬八千八百五十七日又千分日之八百八十三，火星行次輪會日沖日各三十七次。
units.en: Ancient measurement fixed the period at 28,857.883 days, with 37 conjunctions and oppositions per cycle.
units.literal: Ancient period 28,857.883 days; 37 conjunctions and oppositions per cycle.

units.zh: 置中積日分為實，星行次輪周數三十七為法，除之得周率。
units.en: Dividing the total period by 37 revolutions gives the cycle rate.
units.literal: Divide total period by 37 revolutions for cycle rate.

units.zh: 以每周三百六十度為實，周率除之，得每日火星距太陽之行，與每日太陽平行相減，為每日火星平行度。
units.en: Dividing 360° by this rate gives daily motion relative to the sun; subtracting the sun's mean motion gives Mars's daily sidereal mean.
units.literal: Divide 360° by rate for daily solar-relative motion; subtract sun's mean for Mars's daily mean.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，用三次沖日求火星本輪、均輪半徑及最高以定盈縮。
units.en: Second, use three oppositions to determine Mars's deferent and epicycle radii and apogee.
units.literal: Second, use three oppositions for Mars deferent, epicycle, apogee.

units.zh: 明萬曆間西人第谷測火星三次沖日，如第一次日躔元枵宮一十八度五十八分三十八秒，火星在鶉火宮度分秒同；
units.en: Wanli-era Tycho: first opposition sun at Yuanxiao 18°58′38″, Mars at Quehuo with identical coordinates;
units.literal: Wanli Tycho: first sun Yuanxiao 18°58′38″, Mars Quehuo same;

units.zh: 第二次日躔娵訾宮二十三度二十二分，火星在鶉尾宮度分同；
units.en: second: sun at Zi 23°22′, Mars at Weiwei likewise;
units.literal: second sun Zi 23°22′, Mars Weiwei same;

units.zh: 第三次日躔大梁宮一度，火星在大火宮度同。
units.en: third: sun at Daliang 1°, Mars at Dahu with identical coordinates.
units.literal: third sun Daliang 1°, Mars Dahu same.

units.zh: 第一次距第二次七百六十四日一十二時三十二分，實行相距三十四度二十三分二十二秒，平行相距四十度三十九分二十五秒；
units.en: From first to second: 764 days 12h32m; true 34°23′22″, mean 40°39′25″;
units.literal: First to second 764d 12h32m; true 34°23′22″, mean 40°39′25″;

units.zh: 第二次距第三次七百六十八日一十八時，實行相距三十七度三十八分，平行相距四十二度五十二分三十五秒。
units.en: from second to third: 768 days 18h; true 37°38′, mean 42°52′35″.
units.literal: second to third 768d 18h; true 37°38′, mean 42°52′35″.

units.zh: 用不同心圈取平三角形，推得兩心差，為本天半徑千萬分之一百八十五萬五千，析為本輪半徑一百四十八萬四千，均輪半徑三十七萬一千。
units.en: Eccentricity 1,855,000 per 10,000,000—deferent 1,484,000 and epicycle 371,000.
units.literal: Eccentricity 1,855,000; deferent 1,484,000, epicycle 371,000.

units.zh: 又推得萬曆二十八年最高在鶉火宮二十八度五十九分二十四秒，每年最高行一分零七秒。
units.en: Apogee in Wanli 28 at Quehuo 28°59′24″, advancing 1′7″ per year.
units.literal: Wanli 28 apogee Quehuo 28°59′24″, annual advance 1′7″.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求火星次輪半徑以定順逆。
units.en: Third, determine Mars's secondary-deferent radius for retrogradation.
units.literal: Third, find Mars secondary-deferent radius.

units.zh: 西人第谷累年密測，於太陽、火星同在最卑時，測得次輪最小之半徑，為本天半徑千萬分之六百三十萬二千七百五十；
units.en: When sun and Mars were both at perigee, Tycho found minimum secondary-deferent radius 6,302,750 per 10,000,000;
units.literal: Tycho at sun and Mars both perigee: minimum radius 6,302,750 per ten million;

units.zh: 又於太陽在最卑火星在最高時，測得次輪半徑六百五十六萬一千二百五十；
units.en: with the sun at perigee and Mars at apogee, radius 6,561,250;
units.literal: sun perigee Mars apogee: radius 6,561,250;

units.zh: 與最小半徑相較，為本天高卑之大差。
units.en: the difference from the minimum gives the deferent's full range.
units.literal: difference from minimum is deferent high-low range.

units.zh: 又於火星在最卑、太陽在最高時，測得次輪半徑六百五十三萬七千七百五十，與最小半徑相較，為太陽高卑之大差。
units.en: With Mars at perigee and the sun at apogee, the radius was 6,537,750; its difference from the minimum gives the solar range.
units.literal: Mars perigee sun apogee: 6,537,750; difference is solar high-low range.

units.zh: 乃用比例求得火星逐時次輪半徑。
units.en: Proportion then gives Mars's secondary-deferent radius at each moment.
units.literal: Proportion gives Mars's time-varying secondary radius.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 定諸輪左、右旋起數及輪面如土、木星。
units.en: Wheel directions and planes are fixed as for Saturn and Jupiter.
units.literal: Fix wheels as for Saturn and Jupiter.

units.zh: 一，求金星平行度。
units.en: First, determine Venus's mean motion.
units.literal: First, find Venus's mean motion.

units.zh: 古測定二千九百一十九日又千分日之六百六十七，金星行次輪會日退合日各五次。
units.en: Ancient measurement fixed the period at 2919.667 days, with five conjunctions and inferior conjunctions per cycle.
units.literal: Ancient period 2919.667 days; five conjunctions and inferior conjunctions per cycle.

units.zh: 置中積日分為實，星行次輪周數五為法，除之得周率。
units.en: Dividing the period by five revolutions gives the cycle rate.
units.literal: Divide by five revolutions for cycle rate.

units.zh: 以每周三百六十度為實，周率除之，得每日金星在次輪周平行，一名伏見行。
units.en: Dividing 360° by this rate gives daily motion on the secondary deferent, called visibility motion.
units.literal: Divide 360° by rate for daily secondary-deferent motion, called visibility motion.

units.zh: 其本輪心平行，即太陽平行。
units.en: The deferent center's mean motion is the sun's mean motion.
units.literal: Deferent-center mean motion equals solar mean motion.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求金星最高及本輪均輪半徑以定盈縮。
units.en: Second, determine Venus's apogee and deferent and epicycle radii.
units.literal: Second, find Venus apogee and deferent/epicycle radii.

units.zh: 明萬曆十三年，西人第谷於晨夕時，逐日累測金星，得距太陽極遠度，晨夕相等，定兩平行距高卑、左右度亦等。
units.en: In Wanli 13 Tycho measured Venus at dawn and dusk when farthest from the sun; the two maxima were equal, fixing symmetric parallel distances.
units.literal: Wanli 13 Tycho measured Venus morning and evening at maximum solar distance, equal at both, fixing equal parallel distances high-low left-right.

units.zh: 以兩平行宮度相加折半，即最高或最卑線所當宮度。
units.en: Halving the sum of the two parallel longitudes gives the apogee or perigee line.
units.literal: Halve the sum of the two parallel mansions for apogee or perigee line.

units.zh: 又擇晨夕時距太陽極遠度相較，定小度為近最高，大度為近最卑。
units.en: Comparing extreme distances: the smaller value is near apogee, the larger near perigee.
units.literal: Compare extreme distances: smaller near apogee, larger near perigee.

units.zh: 測得最高在實沈宮二十九度一十六分三十九秒，每年最高行一分二十二秒五十七微。
units.en: Apogee at Zhenchen 29°16′39″, advancing 1′22″57‴ per year.
units.literal: Apogee Zhenchen 29°16′39″, annual advance 1′22″57‴.

units.zh: 又用兩測擇平行度，一當最高，一當最卑。
units.en: Two observations were chosen at parallel longitudes, one at apogee and one at perigee.
units.literal: Two observations at parallel degrees, one at apogee one at perigee.

units.zh: 距太陽極遠者，用平三角形及轉比例，推得兩心差為本天半徑千萬分之三十二萬零八百一十四，析為本輪半徑二十三萬一千九百六十二，均輪半徑八萬八千八百五十二。
units.en: At maximum elongation, plane triangles give eccentricity 320,814 per 10,000,000—deferent 231,962 and epicycle 88,852.
units.literal: At maximum solar distance, plane triangles give eccentricity 320,814; deferent 231,962, epicycle 88,852.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 如圖己為地心，辛己為兩心差，戊為最高，庚為最卑，午未為金星平行，即太陽平行，甲丙為金星實行。
units.en: Ji is Earth, Xin–Ji the eccentricity; heavenly-stem Wu is apogee, Geng perigee; earthly-branch Wu–Wei is Venus mean motion, equal to solar mean; Jia–Bing is true motion.
units.literal: Ji geocenter, Xin-Ji eccentricity; heavenly-stem Wu apogee, Geng perigee; earthly-branch Wu-Wei Venus mean=solar mean; Jia-Bing true motion.

units.zh: 又圖戊庚為平行，亥角為實行。
units.en: Wu–Geng is mean motion; the Hai angle is true motion.
units.literal: Wu-Geng parallel, Hai angle true motion.

units.zh: 圖形尚無資料
units.en: Diagram not yet available
units.literal: Diagram data not yet available

units.zh: 一，求金星次輪半徑以定順逆。
units.en: Third, determine Venus's secondary-deferent radius for retrogradation.
units.literal: Third, find Venus secondary-deferent radius.

units.zh: 西人第谷測得金星次輪半徑為本天半徑千萬分之七百二十二萬四千八百五十。
units.en: Tycho found Venus’s secondary-deferent radius at 7,224,850 per 10,000,000.
units.literal: Tycho: 7,224,850 per ten million.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 定本輪心行即太陽平行，均輪心從本輪最高左旋，為自行引數；
units.en: The deferent center follows solar mean motion; the epicycle center moves counterclockwise from apogee as the argument;
units.literal: Deferent center=solar mean; epicycle center counterclockwise from apogee as argument;

units.zh: 次輪心從均輪最近右旋，為倍引數。
units.en: the secondary-deferent center moves clockwise from perigee as the double argument.
units.literal: secondary center clockwise from nearest as double argument.

units.zh: 星從次輪平遠右旋行伏見度。
units.en: The planet moves clockwise from mean distance through visibility motion.
units.literal: Planet clockwise from mean distance on visibility motion.

units.zh: 取金星次輪徑線不與地心參直，與本輪高卑線平行，徑線遠地心之端為平遠，近地心之端為平近，與太陰次輪均輪徑線平行者同。
units.en: The Venus secondary-deferent diameter does not pass through Earth but parallels the deferent's apogee–perigee line; the far end is mean-far, the near mean-near, as for the moon.
units.literal: Venus secondary diameter not through Earth, parallel to deferent high-low line; far end mean-far, near mean-near, as lunar secondary.

units.zh: 本輪、均輪面與黃道平行，次輪面有交角。
units.en: Deferent and epicycle lie in the ecliptic plane; the secondary deferent is inclined.
units.literal: Deferent and epicycle parallel ecliptic; secondary inclined.

units.zh: 如圖甲為地心，乙為本天半周，丙為本輪，丁為均輪，戊為次輪，己為平遠，庚為平近。
units.en: Jia is the Earth; Yi half the deferent; Bing the deferent; Ding the epicycle; Wu the secondary deferent; Ji mean-far; Geng mean-near.
units.literal: A Earth; B half-deferent; C deferent; D epicycle; E secondary; Ji mean-far; Geng mean-near.

units.zh: 一，求水星平行度。
units.en: First, determine Mercury's mean motion.
units.literal: First, find Mercury's mean motion.

units.zh: 古測定一萬六千八百零二日又十分日之四，水星行次輪會日退合日一百四十五次。
units.en: Ancient measurement fixed the period at 16,802.4 days, with 145 conjunctions and inferior conjunctions.
units.literal: Ancient 16,802.4 days; 145 conjunctions and inferior conjunctions.

units.zh: 置中積日分為實，星行次輪周數一百四十五為法，除之得周率。
units.en: Dividing the period by 145 revolutions gives the cycle rate.
units.literal: Divide by 145 for cycle rate.

units.zh: 以每周三百六十度為實，周率除之，得每日水星伏見行。
units.en: Dividing 360° by this rate gives Mercury's daily visibility motion.
units.literal: Divide 360° for daily visibility motion.

units.zh: 其本輪心平行如金星。
units.en: The deferent center's mean motion follows Venus.
units.literal: Deferent mean as Venus.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求水星最高及本輪、均輪半徑以定盈縮。
units.en: Second, determine Mercury's apogee and deferent and epicycle radii.
units.literal: Second, find Mercury apogee and radii.

units.zh: 明萬曆十三年，西人第谷如測金星法，測得水星最高在析木宮初度一十分一十七秒，每年最高行一分四十五秒一十四微。
units.en: In Wanli 13 Tycho used the Venus method: apogee at Ximu 0°10′17″, advancing 1′45″14‴ per year.
units.literal: Wanli 13 Tycho like Venus: apogee Ximu 0°10′17″, annual 1′45″14‴.

units.zh: 定兩心差為本天半徑千萬分之六十八萬二千一百五十五，析為本輪半徑五十六萬七千五百二十三，均輪半徑一十一萬四千六百三十二。
units.en: Eccentricity 682,155 per 10,000,000—deferent 567,523 and epicycle 114,632.
units.literal: Eccentricity 682,155; deferent 567,523, epicycle 114,632.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求水星次輪半徑以定順逆。
units.en: Third, determine Mercury's secondary-deferent radius.
units.literal: Third, find Mercury secondary-deferent radius.

units.zh: 西人第谷測得水星次輪半徑為本天半徑千萬分之三百八十五萬。
units.en: Tycho found the secondary-deferent radius at 3,850,000 per 10,000,000.
units.literal: Tycho: 3,850,000 per ten million.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 定本輪心平行即太陽平行，均輪心從本輪最高左旋，為自行引數；
units.en: Deferent center follows solar mean; epicycle center counterclockwise from apogee;
units.literal: Deferent=solar mean; epicycle counterclockwise from apogee;

units.zh: 次輪心從均輪最遠右旋，為三倍引數。
units.en: the secondary-deferent center moves clockwise from the farthest point as the triple argument.
units.literal: secondary clockwise from farthest as triple argument.

units.zh: 星從次輪平遠右旋行伏見度。
units.en: The planet moves clockwise from mean-far through visibility motion.
units.literal: Planet clockwise from mean-far on visibility motion.

units.zh: 諸輪之面，與金星同。
units.en: Orbital planes follow Venus.
units.literal: Wheel planes as Venus.

units.zh: 一，求五星與黃道交角及交行所在以定距緯。
units.en: Fourth, determine each planet's ecliptic inclination and nodal motion for latitude.
units.literal: Fourth, find planetary ecliptic inclination and node motion for latitude.

units.zh: 新法算書載崇禎元年天正冬至，次日子正，土星正交在鶉首宮二十度四十一分五十二秒，中交在星紀宮二十度四十一分五十二秒，每年交行四十一秒五十三微，本天與黃道交角二度三十一分。
units.en: Per the New Methods, Chongzhen 1 winter solstice at zi: Saturn ascending node Queshou 20°41′52″, descending Xingji 20°41′52″, nodal motion 41″53‴/year, inclination 2°31′.
units.literal: Chongzhen 1 winter solstice next day zi: Saturn ascending node Queshou 20°41′52″, descending Xingji same, node motion 41″53‴/yr, inclination 2°31′.

units.zh: 木星正交在鶉首宮七度零九分零八秒，中交在星紀宮七度零九分零八秒，每年交行一十三秒三十六微，本天與黃道交角一度一十九分四十秒。
units.en: Jupiter ascending node Queshou 7°9′8″, descending Xingji 7°9′8″, 13″36‴/year, inclination 1°19′40″.
units.literal: Jupiter ascending Queshou 7°9′8″, descending Xingji same, 13″36‴/yr, inclination 1°19′40″.

units.zh: 火星正交在大梁宮一十七度零二分二十九秒，中交在大火宮一十七度零二分二十九秒，每年交行五十二秒五十七微，本天與黃道交角一度五十分。
units.en: Mars ascending node Daliang 17°2′29″, descending Dahu 17°2′29″, 52″57‴/year, inclination 1°50′.
units.literal: Mars ascending Daliang 17°2′29″, descending Dahu same, 52″57‴/yr, inclination 1°50′.

units.zh: 金星正交恆距最高前十六度，在實沈宮一十四度一十六分零六秒，中交在析木宮一十四度一十六分零六秒，每年交行一分二十二秒五十七微，次輪面交黃道之角三度二十九分。
units.en: Venus ascending node fixed 16° before apogee at Zhenchen 14°16′6″, descending Ximu 14°16′6″, 1′22″57‴/year, secondary inclination 3°29′.
units.literal: Venus ascending always 16° before apogee, Zhenchen 14°16′6″, descending Ximu same, 1′22″57‴/yr, secondary inclination 3°29′.

units.zh: 水星正交恆與最卑同在實沈宮一度二十五分四十二秒，中交在析木宮一度二十五分四十二秒，每年交行一分四十五秒一十四微。
units.en: Mercury ascending node coincident with perigee at Zhenchen 1°25′42″, descending Ximu 1°25′42″, 1′45″14‴/year.
units.literal: Mercury ascending with perigee Zhenchen 1°25′42″, descending Ximu same, 1′45″14‴/yr.

units.zh: 次輪心在正交當黃道北之角五度零五分十秒，當黃道南之角六度三十一分零二秒；
units.en: At ascending node: 5°5′10″ north of the ecliptic, 6°31′2″ south;
units.literal: At ascending node: 5°5′10″ north of ecliptic, 6°31′2″ south;

units.zh: 次輪心在中交當黃道北之角六度一十六分五十秒，當黃道南之角四度五十五分三十二秒；
units.en: at descending node: 6°16′50″ north, 4°55′32″ south;
units.literal: at descending: 6°16′50″ north, 4°55′32″ south;

units.zh: 次輪心在兩交之中交角皆五度四十分。
units.en: midway between nodes: 5°40′ in both directions.
units.literal: midway between nodes: 5°40′ both ways.

units.zh: 凡五星交行皆順行。
units.en: All five planets have direct nodal motion.
units.literal: All five planets' nodal motion is direct.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求伏見限。
units.en: Fifth, determine visibility limits.
units.literal: Fifth, find visibility limits.

units.zh: 西人多錄某測得金星當地平，太陽在地平下五度；
units.en: The Westerner Duolumou (Ptolemy) found that when Venus is on the horizon, the sun is 5° below it;
units.literal: The Westerner Duolumou measured: Venus at the horizon when the sun is 5° below;

units.zh: 木星水星當地平，太陽在地平下十度；
units.en: Jupiter and Mercury at 10°;
units.literal: Jupiter and Mercury at 10°;

units.zh: 土星當地平，太陽在地平下十一度；
units.en: Saturn at 11°;
units.literal: Saturn at 11°;

units.zh: 火星當地平，太陽在地平下十一度三十分；
units.en: Mars at 11°30′;
units.literal: Mars at 11°30′;

units.zh: 為星見之限。
units.en: as the limits of planetary visibility.
units.literal: as the limit for visibility.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求平行所在。
units.en: First, determine mean-motion position.
units.literal: First, find mean-motion position.

units.zh: 新法算書載崇禎元年天正冬至，次日子正，土星平行距冬至八宮二十八度零八分二十七秒，木星十一宮一十八度五十一分五十一秒，火星五宮零四度四十五分三十秒，金、水同太陽。
units.en: The New Methods record that at Chongzhen 1 winter solstice, next day at zi: Saturn mean motion 8 mansions 28°8′27″ from the solstice, Jupiter 11 mansions 18°51′51″, Mars 5 mansions 4°45′30″, Venus and Mercury with the sun.
units.literal: The New Methods records Chongzhen 1 winter solstice, next day zi: Saturn mean 8 mansions 28°8′27″ from solstice, Jupiter 11 mansions 18°51′51″, Mars 5 mansions 4°45′30″, Venus and Mercury with the sun.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 一，求地半徑差。
units.en: First, determine planetary parallax.
units.literal: Second, find terrestrial semidiameter parallax.

units.zh: 測得地半徑與土星距地心之比例，為一與一萬零九百五十三。
units.en: The ratio of Earth's radius to Saturn's geocentric distance was measured as 1:10,953.
units.literal: Measured ratio of terrestrial radius to Saturn geocentric distance: one to ten thousand nine hundred fifty-three.

units.zh: 與木星距地心之比例，為一與五千九百一十八。
units.en: To Jupiter: 1:5,918.
units.literal: To Jupiter geocentric distance: one to five thousand nine hundred eighteen.

units.zh: 與火星在最高距地心之比例，為一與三千一百二十三；
units.en: To Mars at apogee: 1:3,123;
units.literal: To Mars at apogee: one to three thousand one hundred twenty-three;

units.zh: 在中距之比例，為一與一千七百四十四；
units.en: At mean distance: 1:1,744;
units.literal: at mean distance: one to one thousand seven hundred forty-four;

units.zh: 在最卑之比例，為一與四百一十。
units.en: At perigee: 1:410.
units.literal: at perigee: one to four hundred ten.

units.zh: 與金星在最高距地心之比例，為一與一千九百八十三；
units.en: To Venus at apogee: 1:1,983;
units.literal: To Venus at apogee: one to one thousand nine hundred eighty-three;

units.zh: 在最卑之比例，為一與三百零一；
units.en: At perigee: 1:301;
units.literal: at perigee: one to three hundred one;

units.zh: 中距與太陽同。
units.en: Mean distance is the same as for the sun.
units.literal: Mean distance same as the sun.

units.zh: 與水星在最高距地心之比例，為一與一千六百三十三；
units.en: To Mercury at apogee: 1:1,633;
units.literal: To Mercury at apogee: one to one thousand six hundred thirty-three;

units.zh: 在最卑之比例，為一與六百五十一；
units.en: At perigee: 1:651;
units.literal: at perigee: one to six hundred fifty-one;

units.zh: 中距與太陽同。
units.en: Mean distance is the same as for the sun.
units.literal: Mean distance same as the sun.

units.zh: 土、木二星極遠、高、卑細數不計。
units.en: Fine gradations for Saturn and Jupiter at extreme distances are not tabulated.
units.literal: Saturn and Jupiter extreme far, high, and low fine numbers are not counted.

units.zh: 用平三角形各推得地半徑差。
units.en: Plane triangles then give parallax for each planet.
units.literal: Plane triangles derive parallax for each.

units.zh: 恆星立法之原：
units.en: Foundations of the fixed-star methods:
units.literal: Origins of the methods established for the fixed stars:

units.zh: 一，求各星見行所在。
units.en: First, determine the apparent positions of the fixed stars.
units.literal: First, find each star's apparent position.

units.zh: 康熙十三年，測定恆星經緯度，以十一年壬子列表。
units.en: In Kangxi 13 fixed-star longitudes and latitudes were measured and tabulated for the eleventh year, a renzi year.
units.literal: Kangxi 13 measured fixed-star longitudes and latitudes, tabulated for the eleventh year renzi.

units.zh: 一，求東行度。
units.en: First, determine precession.
units.literal: Second, find eastward motion.

units.zh: 明萬曆間，西人第谷累年精推測，定恆星循黃道每年東行五十一秒。
units.en: During the Wanli era Tycho Brahe, through years of precise calculation and observation, fixed the stars' annual eastward motion along the ecliptic at 51″ per year.
units.literal: During Wanli, the Western scholar Tycho through years of precise calculation and observation fixed stars moving eastward along the ecliptic fifty-one seconds per year.

units.zh: 本法仍之。
units.en: The present system follows the same procedure.
units.literal: The present method follows this.

units.zh: 考成後編日躔歷理云：「西法自多祿某以至第谷，立為本天高卑、本輪、均輪諸說，近世刻白爾、噶西尼等，又以本天為橢圓。」
units.en: The Daily Solar Motion Treatise notes: "From Ptolemy through Tycho came deferents, epicycles, and eccentrics; Kepler and Cassini made the deferent elliptical."
units.literal: Post-Compilation Daily Solar Motion Treatise says: "Western method from Ptolemy to Tycho established deferent heights, epicycle, and eccentric theories; recent Kepler, Cassini, and others took the deferent as an ellipse."
